title: SharePoint: agent access heatmap for SharePoint and OneDrive sites
summary: Hold: the briefing overstates restricted site access protection because external participants in shared channels are not evaluated against that policy. It also treats publication of Agent 365 licence pricing as an open question, although Microsoft already publishes it. The roadmap facts and the documented heatmap controls otherwise check out.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes a visual heatmap of agent activity to detect patterns, hotspots and unusual access behaviour.
claims.quote: Provides a visual heatmap of agent activity to help admins quickly detect patterns, hotspots, and unusual access behavior.

claims.quote: "products": ["OneDrive", "SharePoint"]

claims.fix: Add to this sentence: 'For shared channel sites, this applies only to internal users in the resource tenant; external participants from another tenant are not evaluated against the policy, and their access remains governed by shared-channel and site permissions.' claims.claim: Restricted content discovery is at SharePoint admin center > Sites > Active sites > site > Settings > Restrict content from Microsoft Copilot.
claims.quote: In the SharePoint admin center, expand Sites and select Active sites. Select the site you want to configure. Open the Settings tab, and then turn Restrict content from Microsoft Copilot on.

Enable Restricted Content Discovery for a site
Use PowerShell

claims.quote: By default, only SharePoint administrators can manage Restricted Content Discovery. When delegation is enabled, site administrators can manage Restricted Content Discovery for their sites.

claims.claim: Restricted site access is reached at SharePoint admin center > Sites > Active sites > site > Settings > Restricted site access > Edit.

claims.claim: Set-SPOSite -Identity <siteurl> -RestrictedAccessControl $true enables site access restriction.

Enable site access restriction

claims.where: controls[2].note; Governance controls; Governance guidance: After rollout

claims.claim: Applying site access restriction requires at least one group in the policy.
claims.quote: To apply site access restriction to the site, you must add at least one group to the site access restriction policy.

claims.claim: Restricted access control is documented for OneDrive as well as SharePoint sites.
claims.quote: You can apply this policy on Microsoft 365 group-connected, Teams-connected, nongroup connected sites, and OneDrive by using Microsoft 365 groups or Microsoft Entra security groups.

claims.where: controls[3].ui; Governance controls table row 4; Governance guidance

claims.claim: Start-SPOM365AgentAccessInsightsReport -ReportPeriodInDays 28 generates the existing agent access insights report for the past 28 days.
claims.quote: You can specify a different duration (7, 14, or 28 days) by using the -ReportPeriodInDays parameter. For example, to create a report for the past 28 days, run: Start-SPOM365AgentAccessInsightsReport -ReportPeriodInDays <28>

claims.claim: The existing report's PowerShell route requires at least SharePoint administrator.
